notes.title: Last Update: Hate Free Heroes Leaves Steam - Our appreciation Over the Years
notes.content: [p]Last Update: Words from the developers,[/p][p][/p][p]We greatly appreciate everyone who showed support for this game over the years. [b][i]Hate Free Heroes[/i][/b] is a humorous, lighthearted and heart warming game that was a joy to create and a game that is very dear to our heart. Originally greenlit on Steam (does anyone remember greenlight?), [b][i]Hate Free Heroes[/i][/b] received support from the Steam community and was approved to be put in Steam’s store (this was a great honor back then). An indie game could not get on Steam unless it was greenlit back in those days. We later made an updated version with 3D features and an improved 2D version that was re-released together, this is the game that is now leaving Steam for good. This is our final "Hurrah" for [b][i]Hate Free Heroes"[/i][/b], thank you all for your support.[/p][p][/p][p]Times change and so does the demand for certain games. [b][i]“Hate Free Heroes”[/i][/b] is now leaving the market place for good. We are reducing our catalog to make room for newer and better projects. Maybe one day this project can be re-done with a more advanced engine and improved graphics, but there are no guarantees. We hope everyone enjoyed the game and will keep it in memory.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are giving the chance for people to get this game before we say goodbye to our game for the last time. June 26 (Steam Summer Sale) 50% off, will be the last opportunity to get [b][i]Hate Free Heroes[/i][/b] before it will be removed. After that, we will no longer support this game. It will no longer be available to buy on Steam or anywhere else. [b][i]*Please inform us if this game is still being sold after it is removed.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690790/Hate_Free_Heroes_RPG_2D3D_RPG_Enhanced_Leaving_Steam/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]When a game is removed from the Steam store, we get questions about why it was removed. Unfortunately, we will no longer have time for this game and we are doing our best to inform everyone now about it's retirement. If you don’t have the game and you are interested to own it, the Summer Sale will be the last chance to get the game before we remove it for good.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you everyone for your interest and your support of “Hate Free Heroes”. I don’t like to throw the word “love” around loosely but, I love you all![/p]

notes.title: Hate Free Heroes Major Update! 4.0
notes.content:
We added a major update to Hate Free Heroes RPG and Hate Free Heroes Tactics 4.0 versions.

Each version has been updated to now include the Enhanced 2D and 3D versions of Hate Free Heroes RPG and Hate Free Heroes Tactics (browser based strategy mmo). You will get access to all 3 versions with either purchase. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26545584/a57de65201b2ff8fa439f19846bcd90def38555f.png[/img]

The 2D Enhanced version has been added fully updated with all new features, enhancements but all the fun you expect from the original. If you have lower PC system specs, you can enjoy the 2D version without any issues. You can also select the 3D version and play and/or play the Browser Based MMO at anytime.

Get either version below to get access to ALL 3!

✔️ Hate Free Heroes 2D Enhanced (Enhanced 2D version for lower performance PCs)
✔️ Hate Free Heroes 3D Enhanced (Enhanced 3D version for higher PC performance)
✔️ Hate Free Heroes Tactics (Browser Based Strategy Building MMO)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690790/Hate_Free_Heroes_RPG_2D3D_RPG_Enhanced/
